name: api_openai_gpt_image_2_5_t2i
description: OpenAI GPT Image 2.5 text-to-image. Strong prompt adherence and in-image text rendering, sharper detail than GPT Image 2 at up to half the latency. Runs through the OpenAIGPTImageNodeV2 partner node, which needs ComfyUI v0.35.0 or newer, against your local ComfyUI; billed to your Comfy account (the comfy_cloud API key from `slop-studio auth --comfy-cloud`), not an OpenAI key. aspect_ratio sets an exact custom size of about 1-1.6 MP (1:1 = 1024x1024, 16:9 = 1536x864, 21:9 = 1680x720); omit it and the model picks the size ('auto'). Output carries an alpha channel when background is 'transparent'. OpenAI's backend ignores the seed, so reruns of the same prompt will differ.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate. Natural-language prompts work well; put any text that should appear in the image in quotes.

model.description: Which GPT Image 2.5 variant to run: 'flare' (default) is fast and suits most work; 'sunburst' is slower but more precise, especially across edits.

quality.description: Render quality: 'low', 'medium', 'high' (default), 'xhigh' or 'max'. Cost and time rise with each tier, since billing is by output tokens; use 'low' for drafts.

background.description: Background handling: 'auto' (default), 'opaque', or 'transparent' for a PNG cut-out with an alpha channel (say so in the prompt too, e.g. 'isolated on a transparent background').
